title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 45
description: Ten questions on Psalms 45: the king's noble theme: his sword, throne and scepter, his fragrant garments, and the princess led to his palace.

questions.text: In verse 1, what does the psalmist say his tongue is like?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:1 says, "My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer."

questions.text: According to verse 2, what has anointed the king's lips?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:2 says, "Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever."

questions.text: On behalf of what is the king told to ride on victoriously?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:4 tells the king to ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness.

questions.text: According to verse 6, what kind of scepter is "the scepter of your kingdom"?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:6 says, "A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom."

questions.text: With what oil has God anointed the king above his fellows?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:7 says God has anointed him with the oil of gladness above his fellows.

questions.text: According to verse 8, what do all the king's garments smell like?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:8 says, "All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia."

questions.text: The queen stands at the king's right hand in gold of which place?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:9 says, "At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir."

questions.text: In verse 10, what is the daughter told to forget?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:10 says, "Forget your own people, and also your father's house."

answers.text: Her own people and her father's house

questions.text: Who comes with a gift, according to verse 12?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:12 says, "The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift."

questions.text: According to verse 16, what will the sons be made in all the earth?
questions.explanation: Psalms 45:16 says, "Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth."
